(New in town.)

*Oh adulthood, how everyone loathes, as guess what you were doing? that's right, MOVING! Or at least finishing up moving. You had managed to land a pretty nice house in this town that turned more into a city at the center surrounded by a giant forest on the west side that looked awesome to explore, and a beach past that that was hella popular, a place called Remnant. Odd name, but hey, the house was big, the neighborhood seemed nice, and job searching here didn't look like trying to file taxes when you're 10 years in debt being hunted by the IRS, so hey, take what you can get.*

*So after a month of getting settled in, you decide to head out into town and get a lay of the land, going further in and seeing the more lively side of the place, seeing stuff like a giant grand library that was definitely on the 'visit later' list, a huge mall, a pretty big and apparently popular gym, and even a bakery with a sushi shop right across from it, so hey, pretty nice place so far.*

*Wanting to stock up, you enter the supermarket, grabbing some stuff like some clothes and maybe snacks while exploring just to fill your still pretty empty home, maybe a drink or two as you wander and marvel at how even the humble market store seemed even big and lively, making you wonder what the mall you saw in the distance would have. As you walk through the clothing section just being in a good mood and looking around with a happy wonder, you kinda were just paying attention to everything except in front of you as you rounded the corner, took a few more steps towards what you thought was the checkout counter, annnnnd-*

**Bwooomph♡...mmmoomph♡...griiiind~**

"Nmmmph~...."

*You were suddenly stopped and buckled as you in your blind wandering, finally blindly wandered into someone as you looked forwards, were about to profusely apologize, and looked to see now pressed up against you groin and stomach was the plushest most cushioned ass you've seen as it bounced form you intitial bump and gave a small rolling wave back into you, putting any other model you've seen to shame with its size and plushness, and feeling like a bouncy yet cushiony cloud just smothering your hips, as a verrrrrry dark black-purple sundress skirt that went down to her calves stretched across it as she wore a striped white and purple top with a wrap around her waist holding the skirt up. And as you looked to see her turn her face to you, you see... cat ears?*

*You blanked as she looked... just like this one character to a show you watched... Blake you think she was named? Yeah fictional character, but the resemblance was too uncanny. You see her turn her head as she was bent forwards leaning against a counter for the clothing section, apparently waiting for something before you gave her that firm physical an very much invasive hello. She looks at you with a side eye, not even seeming offended by the scandalous position as she analyzes you for a moment.*

*She shifts her hips to the side, pushing up against you more as if to test if you'll move or not as her eyes linger on where her butt was currently getting very friendly with your front side, but aside from a little eye narrow, she didn't seem even fussed, her ass pushing up slightly with a smooth **grrrrriiiiiiiinnnnnd♡~** as she arches her back with a small stretch.*
